member.name: T:Supabase.Storage.StorageInstrumentation
member.summary:
Diagnostics for the Storage client, exposed through so consumers can subscribe with the OpenTelemetry SDK using (AddSource(...) / AddMeter(...)). Emission is zero-cost when nothing is listening.
Telemetry must never carry secrets or PII: URLs are recorded without their query string (Storage signed URLs put a token there) and no tag may contain a token, credential, or file contents.
Storage covers three HTTP surfaces: the JSON control plane (bucket/file management), and the upload and download transfer paths. Transfers additionally report the number of bytes moved, since a duration alone does not describe a file transfer.
